message.content:
It looks like there might have been a mix‑up with the numbers!  
In reality, **Boston’s** highest recorded temperatures rarely exceed the low 90s °F (≈ 32–35 °C), even on its hottest days. During July and August, the typical daytime highs hover between **75–85 °F (24–29 °C)**, while nighttime lows drop into the mid‑50s °F (12–15 °C).

If you’re planning a trip—or just curious—here’s what you can expect:

| Month | Avg High | Avg Low |
|-------|----------|---------|
| June  | ~78 °F   | ~58 °F  |
| July  | ~82 °F   | ~61 °F  |
| Aug   | ~81 °F   | ~60 °F  |

So while it does feel warm—and sometimes humid—in midsummer, Boston isn’t typically “hot” in the sense of tropical heat. If you’d like tips on staying cool or recommendations for shaded spots, let me know!
